marcadores.explicacao_original: Cavernous spaces are visible in the corpus spongiosum. Some of these spaces are filled with blood and are, therefore, easy to identify at this magnification; more spaces are present but are more difficult to differentiate because they lacked blood at the time the tissue was removed.
